evidence.note: The at_hash in the id_token does not match the hash computed from the access_token supplied. The signature, iss, aud, exp, nbf, iat and nonce checks all passed.

output.fix: Compute at_hash from the exact access_token returned in the same token response as this id_token. at_hash is the base64url encoding of the left half of the SHA-256 digest of the ASCII access token, because the alg is RS256. Make sure the client isn't pairing an id_token with an access token from a different response, such as a refresh or an earlier login. Also make sure it hasn't altered or truncated the token. Keep at_hash validation on. Don't skip it to make the error go away.
